prompt:
Subject:
Sea breeze with a straw hat

Main Figure:
A waist-up portrait of a woman on a sunny beach, facing away and looking back over her shoulder. The focal points are a large open-weave straw hat with a black rim, a white lace swimsuit, and the turquoise sea.

Character and Expression:
Torso facing right, face turned back over the left shoulder toward the camera with a soft smile showing teeth and steady brown eyes. Small oval face, rounded chin, round almond eyes, thin parallel brows, thin nose bridge with a small tip, and glossy pale coral lips. Bright skin with natural blush and thin eyeliner. Wet light brown shoulder-length hair with thin bangs and delicate strands around the face, flipping slightly outward at the ends.

Attire and Pose:
An extremely wide-brimmed straw hat in natural open-weave with a black ribbon band and black wavy edging. A white floral lace halter bikini with white ties visible at the back of the neck and center back. Right shoulder pulled toward the camera, with her right hand (left side of the frame) lightly pinching the left edge of the hat.

Background and Lighting:
White waves and pale sand at the bottom, vibrant turquoise sea in the center background, and blue sky with scattered white clouds in the top half. Hard summer direct light from above casts a fine speckled shadow from the hat's weave onto her face and brightly edges the shoulders and hair.

Composition and Camera:
A 3:4 vertical close-up portrait at eye level, capturing the entire hat to above the waist. The large hat occupies the upper half and sides, face at center-left, bare back at center-bottom. Focus on the face, with the sea and clouds softly blurred by shallow depth of field.

Texture and Style:
Bright photorealistic photography. High-definition rendering of the straw weave, black trim, wet hair, white lace, skin, and waves, with a refreshing contrast of blue, white, and natural tones.

Negative:
Do not shrink the large wavy brim of the hat; do not face the over-the-shoulder look forward.
